get.summary: The access administration overview.
Every catalog permission, retired ones included, sorted by key.
Every role, virtual roles first.

post.summary: Creates an active, ordinary role (201).

get.summary: One role with its permissions.

put.summary: Changes a role's names, permissions and active state.

get.summary: Up to 20 accounts matching the search (active and deactivated).
One user's roles, direct grants, virtual roles and effective permissions.

put.summary: Replaces one user's roles and direct grants (live on the user's next request, no relogin).

get.summary: One page of the audit trail, newest first (values already masked).

parameters.name: EntityType
parameters.description: The audited entity type name (as the trail lists it), or null for all.

parameters.name: EntityId
parameters.description: One row of EntityType (needs the type), or null for all.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: Only entries older than this one (the cursor: the last id of the previous page), or null.

parameters.name: Take
parameters.description: The page size, 1 to int AuditPaging.MaxTake; null is int AuditPaging.DefaultTake.

get.summary: Every registered job with its newest run, ordered by key.

post.summary: Queues a run of the job now; a job server runs it as the system actor.

get.summary: The newest runs of the job, newest first.

parameters.name: Take
parameters.description: How many runs, newest first: 1 to int JobsLimits.MaxHistoryTake; int JobsLimits.DefaultHistoryTake when absent.

get.summary: Every lookup type with its value count, ordered by key.
Every value of one lookup type, active or not, ordered by sort order.

put.summary: Activates or deactivates one value (the only run-time change a lookup accepts).

post.summary: Sends the caller a test notification: the bell now, e-mail (and SMS when enabled) through the outbox.

get.summary: One page of organizations, ordered by code.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Matched against the code and both names.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size (default int UsersLimits.DefaultPageSize, at most int UsersLimits.MaxPageSize).

post.summary: Creates an active organization.

get.summary: One organization.

put.summary: Changes an organization's code, names and kind.

post.summary: Deactivates an organization (its accounts stay; it accepts no new member).
Reactivates an organization.

get.summary: One page's current content (never cached); 404 for an unknown page key.

put.summary: Replaces one page's sections and answers the page as stored; 400, 404 or 409 otherwise.

get.summary: Every setting, ordered by group, then key.

put.summary: Changes a setting's value; every node sees it within `SettingsLimits.CacheTtl`.

post.summary: Reads and validates the sheet and stores the batch; nothing is created yet.
Creates the accounts of the batch's valid rows (no passwords; activation links for password-bound rows).

get.summary: One page of accounts with their organization names.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Matched against the user name, display name and e-mail address.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size (default int UsersLimits.DefaultPageSize, at most int UsersLimits.MaxPageSize).

post.summary: Creates an account without a password; a password-bound one comes back with its activation link.

get.summary: One account.

post.summary: Issues a new activation link (password binding only); the current password stops working.
Deactivates the account; its open sessions answer 401 from their next call.
Reactivates the account.
Ends a lockout.
Sets the account's password from an activation link; the link is spent.
Signs in with a directory user name and password.
Signs in with a user name and password.
Ends the caller's session; the access token in hand is refused from the next request on.

get.summary: The switched-on login modes (`Auth:Modes`).

post.summary: Rotates the refresh token and issues a new access token.
Trades the one-time ticket for the session (the same body as `/api/auth/login`).

get.summary: Starts a sign-in: 302 to the identity provider.

post.summary: Ends the caller's session: 200 with the provider's end_session URL for an SSO session, else 204.

get.summary: The provider's redirect back: 302 to the SPA callback with `#ticket=` or `#error=`.
The dashboard's data.
Every declared flag and its effective value.
The active values of one lookup type, ordered by sort order (both names; the client picks the language).
The permission keys the caller holds now.
One page of the caller's notifications, newest first, in the request language.
How many of the caller's notifications are unread.

post.summary: Marks one of the caller's notifications read (idempotent).

Stores a contact message and answers its reference number (201), the field errors (400), 409 while an
administrator has switched the form off, or 429.

get.summary: One page's content; 404 for an unknown page key.

AccessUserResponse.description: One account of the user picker (`GET /api/admin/access/users`).

AccountBinding.description:
How an account proves who it is: the one sign-in mode the account accepts. Stored and sent as the integer value;
labels come from the client's i18n bundles, never from the member names.

loginName.description: The directory login name, or null.

upn.description: The user principal name, or null.

oneOf.description: The kind.
The binding.
The organization, or null.

organizationValue.description: The organization's internal id, or null.

AccountFields.description: The account fields a create and an update share, as sent.

ticket.description: The sealed ticket from the activation link's fragment.

ActivationDelivery.description: How an activation link reaches the user. Sent on the wire as the integer value.

activationLink.description:
The link (the sealed one-time ticket is in its fragment) when Delivery is AdministratorLink (1);
null when it is Email (2), because the user receives the link by e-mail.

expiresAt.description: When it stops working (an e-mailed link expires a little later, by the outbox delay).

ActivationResponse.description: An activation just issued: e-mailed to the user, or a link to hand over.

isActive.description: False when the role grants nothing.

AssignedRoleResponse.description: An assigned role of a grants response.

AuditAction.description: What happened to an audited row (stored as int; never reorder or renumber).

oneOf.description: The audited row, or null for a composite key.

changes.description: The recorded values (masked where personal; ids are tokens).

hasMore.description: True when older entries exist; ask again with `before` = the last item's id.

AuditPageResponse.description: One page of the audit trail.

code.description: The unique code (letters, digits, `_`, `-`; stored upper-case).

oneOf.description: Internal (1) or external (2).

code.description: The stable code (lower-case kebab, RoleCodeFormat); it never changes.

permissions.description: The permission keys the role grants (each in the live catalog).

CreateRoleCommand.description: The body of `POST /api/admin/access/roles`, validated by CreateRoleValidator.

displayName.description: The name shown in the shell and the lists.

email.description: The e-mail address (unique when given), or null.

loginName.description: The directory login name (unique when given), or null.

upn.description: The user principal name (unique when given), or null.

oneOf.description: Internal (1) or external (2).
Password (1), Active Directory (2) or SSO (3).
The organization; required for an external user.

fields.description: The fields a create shares with an update.

CreateUserCommand.description:
The body of `POST /api/admin/users`. There is no password field: a password-bound account gets an activation
link, an Active Directory or SSO account signs in through its directory or identity provider.

oneOf.description: Its activation (password binding only), or null.

DirectGrantResponse.description: A direct grant of a grants response.

userName.description: The directory user name as the user types it (`user`, `DOMAIN\user` or `user@domain`).

flags.description: Every declared flag name to its effective value. Flags only: never an identity or a setting.

FeaturesResponse.description: The feature flags of this deployment, as the client reads them.

isActive.description: False for a deactivated account (it holds nothing).

kind.description: Internal (1) or external (2): selects the virtual roles.

isBreakGlass.description: True for the break-glass administrator (holds everything; not editable).

GrantUserResponse.description: The user of a grants response.

rows.description: Every data row with its verdict.

invalidCount.description: The number of rows with an error.

oneOf.description: The parsed kind, or null when invalid.
The parsed binding, or null when invalid.

valid.description: True when the row will become an account.

errors.description: The row's error codes (`errors.<CODE>` on the client); empty when valid.

ImportPreviewRowResponse.description: One row of an import preview.

activationLink.description: The activation link of a password-bound account without an e-mail address, or null.

expiresAt.description: When the activation stops working, or null.

oneOf.description: AdministratorLink (1), Email (2: the link is e-mailed, no link here), or null.

activationErrorCode.description: Why a password-bound account got no link (rare; issue one from the users list), or null.

cron.description: The five-field cron schedule (jobs time zone), or null for a manual-only job.

oneOf.description: The newest run, or null when it never ran.

JobResponse.description: One registered job on the wire, with its newest run.

actor.description: The actor the run's work is recorded under: always `SYSTEM`.

triggeredBy.description:
The display name of the administrator who ran it now, or null for a scheduled run (or an account that no longer
exists). Never the internal subject id.

startedAt.description: When it started executing, or null while queued.

referenceCode.description: The reference code of a failed execution (quote it to find the log line), or null.

JobRunResponse.description: One job run on the wire. Times are ISO 8601 UTC; enums are their integer values.

JobRunStatus.description: The state of one job run (stored and sent as the integer value).

JobTrigger.description: Why a job run started (stored and sent as the integer value).

LoginModesResponse.description: The login methods the login page offers.

LookupItemResponse.description: One value of `GET /api/admin/lookups/{type}`, active or not.

itemCount.description: The number of its values, active or not.

permissions.description: The permission keys the caller holds now, sorted.

hasMore.description: True when older items exist (ask again with `before` = the last item's id).

read.description: Whether the caller has read it.

NotificationResponse.description: One bell item on the wire (texts already in the request language).

OrganizationKind.description:
Whose organization it is: the one running the portal (its departments) or an outside one (a partner entity).
Stored and sent as the integer value; labels come from the client's i18n bundles, never from the member names.

total.description: The number of matches on every page.

key.description: The permission key (in the live catalog).
The key; the editors build their tree from its dotted segments.

isRetired.description: True when the key left the code (grants nothing, cannot be granted).

PermissionScope.description:
How far a held permission reaches. Stored and sent as the integer value. When a user holds the same permission at
both scopes, PermissionScope.Global wins.

PermissionSourceKind.description: Where an effective permission comes from. Stored nowhere; sent as the integer value.

kind.description: Direct (1), role (2), virtual role (3) or break-glass (4).

oneOf.description: The role's PublicId, or null for a direct grant and break-glass.

PermissionSourceResponse.description: One source of an effective permission.

updatedAt.description: When an administrator last changed it (ISO 8601, UTC), or null for the seeded text.

sections.description: The sections, ordered by sort order.

PortalSectionResponse.description: One bilingual section on the wire (plain text; body paragraphs separated by a blank line).

PublicIdOfAuditEntryIds.description: An opaque identifier: 'm1', the key id and 48 base64url characters, separated by underscores. Server-minted and bound to one identifier family; a token of another family is refused like a malformed one. No identifier has a numeric spelling on the wire.

PublicIdOfPortalSectionIds.description: An opaque identifier: 'm1', the key id and 48 base64url characters, separated by underscores. Server-minted and bound to one identifier family; a token of another family is refused like a malformed one. No identifier has a numeric spelling on the wire.

roles.description: The ordinary roles the user holds after the write.

permissions.description: The direct grants the user holds after the write.

confirmBreakGlassOnly.description:
True accepts that the write leaves only the break-glass administrator able to manage access (otherwise refused
with string AccessErrorCodes.LastManager).

PutUserGrantsCommand.description:
The body of `PUT /api/admin/access/users/{userId}/grants`: the user's complete set of roles and direct grants
(replaces both), validated by PutUserGrantsValidator. A role or key listed twice keeps its widest
scope.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token from the login or the previous refresh.

RejectedImportRowResponse.description: A row the commit left out.

sections.description: Every section the page should hold (at most int PortalLimits.MaxSectionsPerPage; may be empty).

ReplacePortalContentCommand.description:
The body of `PUT /api/admin/portal/content/{page}`: the page's complete list of sections. A section with an
id updates that section, one without an id is added, and a section of the page that the list leaves out is removed.

roleId.description: The role's PublicId (an ordinary role; a virtual role is refused).

scope.description: How far the role's permissions reach for the user.

isActive.description: False when the role grants nothing.

oneOf.description: The users a virtual role reaches (int), or null.

permissions.description: The keys the role grants, sorted.

warnings.description: Warning codes of the write (`ACCESS_ONLY_BREAK_GLASS_MANAGES`); empty on a read.

RoleResponse.description: One role with its permissions (GET, POST and PUT of the roles routes).

isActive.description: False when the role grants nothing.

isVirtual.description: True for a virtual role (never assignable).

oneOf.description: The users a virtual role reaches (int), or null.

permissionCount.description: How many permissions the role grants.

oneOf.description: The section's PublicId to update it, or null to add a new section.

bodyAr.description: The Arabic body (plain text, paragraphs separated by a blank line).

sortOrder.description: The display order, int PortalLimits.SortOrderMin to int PortalLimits.SortOrderMax.

refreshToken.description: The refresh token (single use: every refresh returns a new one).

idleTimeoutMinutes.description: The idle timeout the client enforces, in minutes.

SessionResponse.description: The body of a successful login or refresh.

alg.description: Always `HMAC-SHA256`; an algorithm change is a visible wire change.

sessionSigningKey.description: The 32-byte derived session key, base64. Never the master.

audience.description: The audience every proof must carry (a signed field the client cannot guess).

verifyResponses.description: True when the server signs responses (response signing is not Off).

serverTimeUnix.description: The server clock, so the client can correct its skew.

SessionSigningKeyResponse.description: The signing block the client stores per session. Wire names are camelCase and fixed (the client reads them).

SessionUserResponse.description: A signed-in user as the client sees it.

isActive.description: True to offer the value again, false to retire it.

group.description: The group the screen lists it under.

valueType.description: How the value reads (integer on the wire).

updatedAt.description: When an administrator last changed it (ISO 8601 UTC), or null.

SettingResponse.description: One runtime setting on the wire (the bounds stay server-side; a value outside them is refused with a field error).

SettingValueType.description:
How a runtime setting's text value is read and validated. Stored and sent on the wire as the integer value; the
client labels it from its ar and en bundles.

ticket.description: The one-time ticket from the callback's URL fragment.

bindingProof.description: The binding secret whose hash started the sign-in (required: without it the ticket is rejected).

endSessionUrl.description: The identity provider's end_session URL; open it with a top-level GET (not fetch).

SsoLogoutResponse.description: The end of an SSO logout.

fullName.description: The sender's name (1-100 characters after trimming).

topicId.description: The contact topic: an active `contact-topics` lookup id (`ContactTopicIds`).

language.description: The language to reply in: `ar` or `en` (ContactLanguageCodes).

SubmitContactMessageCommand.description:
The body of `POST /api/portal/contact-messages`. Every member is nullable, so a missing field comes back as a
field error of the validator rather than as a binding failure in another shape.

TriggeredJobRunResponse.description: The answer to "run now": the queued run's PublicId (its outcome appears in the run history).

count.description: How many of the caller's notifications are unread.

oneOf.description: Internal (1) or external (2); it cannot change while accounts belong to the organization.

UpdateOrganizationCommand.description: The body of `PUT /api/admin/organizations/{id}` (the same fields as a create).

permissions.description: The permission keys the role grants after the write (replaces the set).

isActive.description: False deactivates the role (it then grants nothing; assignments stay).

confirmBreakGlassOnly.description:
True accepts that the write leaves only the break-glass administrator able to manage access (otherwise refused
with string AccessErrorCodes.LastManager).

UpdateRoleCommand.description: The body of `PUT /api/admin/access/roles/{id}`, validated by UpdateRoleValidator.

value.description: The new value as text, in the setting's format (see SettingValueFormat).

displayName.description: The name shown in the shell and the lists.

email.description: The e-mail address (unique when given), or null.

loginName.description: The directory login name (unique when given), or null.

upn.description: The user principal name (unique when given), or null.

oneOf.description: Internal (1) or external (2).
Password (1), Active Directory (2) or SSO (3).
The organization; required for an external user.

UpdateUserCommand.description: The body of `PUT /api/admin/users/{id}` (the user name never changes).

roles.description: The assigned ordinary roles with their scopes.

permissions.description: The direct grants with their scopes.

virtualRoles.description: The virtual roles that match the user's kind.

warnings.description: Warning codes of the write; empty on a read.

UserGrantsResponse.description:
The body of `GET` and `PUT /api/admin/access/users/{userId}/grants`: the editable rows (roles and direct
permissions), the virtual roles that reach the user, and what the user holds now with every source.

UserKind.description:
Who a user is to the organization running the portal. Stored and sent as the integer value; labels come from the
client's i18n bundles, never from the member names.

total.description: The number of matches on every page.

loginName.description: The directory login name, or null.

upn.description: The user principal name, or null.

oneOf.description: The organization's PublicId, or null.

organizationName.description: The organization's name in the request language, or null.

hasPassword.description: True once a password-bound account has set its password through the activation link.

isLockedOut.description: True while failed sign-ins keep it locked.

isBreakGlass.description: True for the configured break-glass administrator.

UserResponse.description: An account as the admin screens see it (never a password, hash or ticket).

isActive.description: False when the role grants nothing.

VirtualRoleResponse.description: A virtual role that reaches the user.
